desc: The MAGPUL PMAG 7.62MM D-50 LR/SR GEN M3 (MAG993-BLK) is a lightweight 50-round polymer drum magazine designed for 7.62x51 NATO/.308 Winchester ammunition for SR25/M110 pattern rifles. It's capable of using longer-than-SAAMI-spec match ammunition, up to 2.830 OAL, such as M118LR. The D-50 has a crush-resistant polymer construction and slip-on semi-rigid dust cover. The stainless-steel internals withstands corrosion and long-term storage while loaded with no loss of function, spring fatigue, or reliability concerns. To make handloading done with ease, the D-50 has a ratcheting loading lever that removes the spring tension. With a simple flat blade screwdriver or a similar tool, the D-50 can be disassembled with ease. At approximately 1.7 lbs empty, and 4.5 lbs loaded, the Magpul D-50 is one of the lightest 50-round 7.62x51/.308 drums available. The unique design gives the D-50 the same overall height profile as a standard 25-round PMAG.
